neighbours.label: a discourse pivot right after a contrast or concession marker in opinion prose ('But as', '... however', 'Now')
fire: It will fill up with dirt in three seconds. But as a cycling gadget it is pure genius.
The first season was weak. The second season, however, is much more exciting.
The book was praised when it came out. Now the author has revised and updated it.
Critics hated the ending. But as a piece of music, the finale is remarkable.
Many people doubted the plan. The results, however, proved them completely wrong.
The film was a failure in 1990. Now it is considered a cult classic by many fans.
The car is not very fast. But as a family vehicle it is hard to beat.
The old theory was popular for decades. Its predictions, however, were rarely tested.
quiet: It will fill up with dirt in three seconds and then stop working completely.
The first season was weak and the second season was weak in the same way.
The book was praised when it came out and sold many copies in its first year.
Critics hated the ending and complained about the music in the final scene.
Many people doubted the plan and wrote letters to the newspaper about it.
The film was a failure in 1990 and was quickly forgotten by most viewers.
The car is not very fast and uses a lot of fuel on the motorway.
The old theory was popular for decades and was taught in every school.

notes: low-confidence guess; top examples are mixed tokens in contrastive prose
